CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.AtkObiekt @Akcja smallint, @AtOAtkID int, @AtOGIDTyp int, @ATOElement smallint,
@ATOLp smallint = NULL, @ATOWymagany smallint = -1, @ATOAutomat smallint = -1, @ATOReadOnly smallint = -1, @ATZID int = 0, @ATOAkcja int = 0 AS SET NOCOUNT ON IF @AtoAtkID < 1 BEGIN SELECT 1 AS ERROR RETURN 1 END IF @Akcja = 2 BEGIN DELETE FROM CDN.AtrybutyObiekty WHERE AtO_AtkID = @AtOAtkID AND AtO_GIDTyp = @AtOGIDTyp AND AtO_Element = @ATOElement IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK TRAN RAISERROR('Błąd usuwania powiązania obiektu z klasą',16,1) RETURN 1 END SELECT 0 AS ERROR,1 AS DELSTAT END ELSE IF @Akcja = 1 BEGIN IF @ATZID > 0 BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT AZO_ATZID FROM CDN.AtrybutyZrodlaObiekty WHERE AZO_ATZID = @ATZID AND AZO_ATOGIDTyp = @AtOGIDTyp AND AZO_ATOElement = @ATOElement) BEGIN SELECT 3 AS ERROR RETURN 3 END END IF @ATOLp IS NULL SELECT @ATOLp = (ISNULL(MAX(AtO_Lp),0)+10) FROM CDN.AtrybutyObiekty WHERE AtO_AtkID = @AtoATKID INSERT INTO CDN.AtrybutyObiekty (AtO_GIDTyp,AtO_Element,AtO_AtkID,AtO_Lp,AtO_Wymagany,AtO_Automat,AtO_ReadOnly,AtO_ATZID,AtO_Akcja,Ato_Online) VALUES (@AtOGIDTyp,@ATOElement,@AtOAtkID,@ATOLp,@ATOWymagany,@ATOAutomat,@ATOReadOnly,@ATZID,@ATOAkcja,0) IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK TRAN RAISERROR('Błąd dodawania powiązania obiektu z klasą',16,1) RETURN 1 END SELECT @AtOAtkID AS AtO_AtkID,@AtOGIDTyp AS AtO_GIDTyp,@ATOElement AS AtO_Element,@ATOLp AS AtO_LP,@ATOWymagany AS AtO_Wymagany,@ATOAutomat AS AtO_Automat,@ATOReadOnly AS AtO_Automat,@ATZID AS AtO_ATZID,@ATOAkcja AS AtO_Akcja END ELSE BEGIN SELECT 2 AS ERROR RETURN 2 END SET NOCOUNT OFF
